items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Me and him just started together in Sox's Lane. And then we made up a band with Skeeter.

ctx.x: I heard him on records. Yeah. With Freddie Kepler.

With Freddie Kepler. That's right. Mm-hmm. Well, I was the one who pitched him. Mm-hmm. Yeah. Me and him just started together in Sox's Lane. Mm-hmm. That's been years ago. Mm-hmm. And then we made up a band with Skeeter. Like you see, it was Skeeter and different fellas. And I coached him playing all around. And then I started to take a lesson with the violin. You understand? I was playing to get all my cymbals. I didn't play in the band without him. Mm-hmm. After I started taking lessons, I got to divide and I…
